issues.description: The problem statement and UML require the Lecture constructor to initialize attributes in the order shown in the UML (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors). The solution implementation provides a constructor with a different parameter order (lectureName, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents). This mismatch contradicts the explicit instruction about constructor parameter order and could confuse students about the expected constructor signature (and cause failing tests that validate parameter order).
issues.suggestedFix: Rename or reorder the constructor parameters in the solution to match the UML and problem instructions: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors). Alternatively, update the problem statement/UML to explicitly reflect the constructor parameter order used in the solution, so both artifacts agree.
